questions.question: The incident ray, the _________ at the point of incidence and the reflected ray all lie in the same plane.
questions.solution: The incident ray, the normal at the point of incidence and the reflected ray all lie in the same plane.

questions.question: Blue Vitriol is another name for which of the following?
questions.solution: Blue Vitriol is another name for Copper Sulphate. It is a toxic chemical that has uses in making antidote, dyeing of vegetables and in various forms of artwork.

questions.question: The demand for an inferior good decrease with ________ in the consumer's income.
questions.solution:
The demand for an inferior good decrease with an increase in the consumer's income. This is because the consumer is now able to afford a product of a better quality. 

In Inferior goods its depend on salary or income of a customer.

Inferior goods are those goods for example a soap and shower gel now when consumer income is low he will buy soap but when his income increases he will go for shower gel because now he can afford it and for him now soap is an inferior good.

questions.question: Which nation will host the FIFA Men's World Cup to be held in the year 2018?
questions.solution: FIFA Men’s world Cup, to be held in 2018, will be hosted by Russia. It will be the 21st FIFA World Cup and is scheduled to take place in from 14 June to 15 July 2018.

questions.question: Biological names are generally derived from which language?
questions.solution: Biological or Binomial nomenclature is a formal system of naming species of living things by giving each a name composed of two parts, both of which use Latin words.

questions.question: The members of rhodophyceae are commonly called _________ algae.

questions.question: Energy in the form of heat is wasted when a machine is operated. This heat is generated due to ___________.
questions.solution: Energy in the form of heat is wasted when a machine is operated. This heat is generated due to friction.

questions.question: _________ is the breaking up of the rocks on the earth's surface.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Weathering**__

 
• Weathering is the breaking down of rocks, soil, and minerals as well as wood and artificial materials through contact with the Earth's atmosphere, waters, and biological organisms.
 
• 
 
Weathering and Erosion are geological processes that act together to shape the surface of the Earth. Erosion is the displacement of solids (soil, mud, rock and other particles) usually by the agents of currents such as wind, water, or ice by downward or down-slope movement in response to gravity or by living organisms. Weathering is the decomposition of rocks, soils, and minerals through direct contact with the Earth's atmosphere.

 
 
• Denudation refers to the wearing down, stripping, and leveling of the earth's surface. This is caused by rivers, glaciers, waves, and wind. there are three denudation processes: Erosion, Weathering, and mass wasting.
 
• The word ‘denude’ means to strip off or to uncover. All the exogenic geomorphic processes are covered under a general term called Denudation. 
 
• Weathering, mass wasting/movements, erosion, and transportation are included in denudation.

NOTE: 

 
• Hydration is a form of chemical weathering that involves the rigid attachment of H+ and OH- ions to the atoms and molecules of a mineral.
 
• The processes of Decomposition (or chemical weathering) transform rocks and minerals exposed to water and atmospheric gases into new chemical compounds (different rocks and minerals), some of which can be dissolved away.
 
• Carbonation: When carbon dioxide is added to the rocks and minerals it may result in their dissolution.

questions.question: In March 2017, in which country was "world's largest artificial sun”, switched on?
questions.solution: Scientists in Germany have switched on “the world’s largest artificial sun” in March 2017 in the hope that intense light sources can be used to generate climate-friendly fuel. The name of the project is Synlight .

questions.question: Goods for which the quantity that a consumer chooses, increases as the consumer's income increases and decreases as the income decreases are called?
questions.solution: Goods for which the quantity that a consumer chooses, increases as the consumer's income increases and decreases as the income decreases are called normal goods.

questions.question: "Prevention of cruelty to animals" is listed in the ________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution: "Prevention of cruelty to animals" is listed as entry 17 in the Concurrent list (List-III) given in the Constitution of India which means a law on the subject matter can be made by States as well as Centre governments.
